verdict.rationale: Probes confirm that Cline publishes a live llms.txt at docs.cline.bot. Its docs pages are also served as Markdown (.md), and each page points agents to the llms.txt documentation index, so a user can point an agent straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other full-content bundle, and no independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.cline.bot/llms.txt # Cline
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.cline.bot/llms.txt
